trusted_sections: 7 Layer 2 - Control, diagnostics, and snapshot ownership
Work Package PX0-01 - Contract Boundary Cleanup

trusted_statements.objective: Decouple RuntimeFacade product control/state from Runtime diagnostics while preserving the DUI-M1 common Canvas control adapter and current product behavior.
preserved_semantics: CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter remains the common Windows/Web product CanvasControl adapter backed by CanvasControlService; PX0-01 must not recreate or bypass that lane.
RuntimeFacade remains the product-safe mutation/state boundary but no longer inherits RuntimeDiagnostics.
RuntimeDiagnostics/IAxiomDiagnostics remains a read-only diagnostics owner contract independent of RuntimeFacade.
WindowsRuntimeFacade and WebRuntimeFacade continue to derive from CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter and separately implement IAxiomDiagnostics.
Windows/Web local DebugSnapshot assembly remains in place until PX0-02; PX0-01 must not move snapshot ownership.
DebugPanelModel remains in place until PX0-04; PX0-01 must not redesign panel/workbench structure.
Generic debug_ui::DebugCommand remains in place until PX0-03.
Stable Runtime C ABI must not change as an incidental consequence.

runtime_state_target.shape: RuntimeStateSnapshot grouped as identity/tool/camera/history/selection product-safe projections

trusted_statements.product_request_rule: ProductControlRequest core action semantics and existing enum numeric values are preserved. setBrush() must encode brushId/brushRevision without overloading toolId; setEraser() must encode eraserId without overloading toolId. Platform adapters derive temporary host/UI selection identity from brushId/eraserId or current CanvasControl state rather than relying on overloaded toolId.
trusted_statements.feature_diagnostics_rule: Introduce a typed built-in FeatureDiagnosticsSnapshot seam for Ink, Shape, RichText, Connector, Snap, and Image. PX0-01 does not invent successor-feature payload semantics; unsupported successor sections remain empty/default.
trusted_statements.diagnostic_ownership_rule: Axiom/Arc/Platform/Telemetry diagnostics remain read-only owner seams. Product Shell consumers can compile against RuntimeFacade without diagnostics capability.
trusted_statements.dui_evidence_boundary: GT-DUI-M1 physical status remains BLOCKED_EVIDENCE/PHYSICAL_PENDING and is not modified or reinterpreted by PX0-01.

forbidden_interpretations: DUI-M1 CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter is not obsolete merely because RuntimeFacade changes shape.
PX0-01 does not authorize common DebugSnapshotAssembler, DebugControlRouter, Activity Log, Workbench shell, feature panels, or host convergence.
PX0-01 does not authorize Shape/RichText/Connector/Snap/Image product behavior.
PX0-01 does not authorize fixing deferred Windows preview visibility or changing GT-DUI-M1 evidence.
